product.title: The only Paris Wine Tasting experience you need to do - 2 hours

description.text: Learn all about French wine on this small-group, guided tour right in the heart of Paris. Sample around six to seven French wines in an unpretentious atmosphere with a charismatic guide. Stops include Paris Wine Co, 7 Rue Bargue. Discuss which are your favorites with your small group as your French sommelier guide explains each one. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Paris Wine Co, 7 Rue Bargue that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Paris, and the itinerary keeps visitors close to Seine views, museum galleries, and historic streets that shape this French capital tour.
